content.text:
The result of (128 + 256) ÷ 4 is **96**. The Calculator shows "384 ÷ 4 = 96".

The Calculator follows standard precedence, so I had to press Equals after the addition to get 384 before dividing. Two of my first attempts had digit-entry mistakes, and I cleared them before the final run.
